name: Leading Edge Data Centres Newcastle (Mayfield West)
notes: Regional Tier III edge colocation at Mayfield West, Newcastle LGA; ~75-rack edge facility; LEDC announced a $19.6m Newcastle/Hunter investment covering four 375kW facilities (1.5MW total). LEDC Newcastle, Tamworth, Dubbo and Albury reported operational per DigitalBridge-backed build-out; no large hyperscale project found in Newcastle LGA.

name: 5G Networks North Sydney Data Centre (St Leonards)
notes: Small carrier colocation in St Leonards (North Sydney LGA); directory-listed with 3 network carriers (5G Networks AS63956, Intergrid AS133480, Tello Services AS133130). No major new-build or SSD found for North Sydney LGA; capacity not disclosed.

name: Equinix SY6 (Silverwater) Data Centre
notes: Equinix SY6 is a modular BladeRoom-format facility in Silverwater (City of Parramatta LGA), formerly Metronode Sydney 2; Stage 2/3 mechanical works dated June 2022; ~4MW reported by DCPulse. Only concrete datacentre facility identified in Parramatta LGA (Silverwater suburb; LGA boundary with Cumberland should be re-checked if precise siting matters).

name: Mamre Road Data Centre Campus (Kemps Creek)
notes: SSD-92743706 at 706-752 Mamre Road, Kemps Creek (Western Sydney Employment Area, Penrith LGA). EIS describes construction/operation of a data centre campus with ~1GW power capacity, six four-storey data centre buildings, 936 cooling units, 852 diesel back-up generators; UrbanDigest reports $9bn cost, 227,584 sqm GFA on 52ha, entered exhibition Aug 2026. capacity_mw recorded on EIS power-capacity basis, not IT load.

name: Microsoft Datacenter Kemps Creek (769 Mamre Road)
notes: Voluntary Planning Agreement (VPA) publicly notified by Penrith City Council (Mar 2023) for Microsoft datacenter development at 769 Mamre Road, Kemps Creek (Lot 2 DP 1271142), under State Significant Development Application 10101987. Kemps Creek is in Penrith LGA.

name: CDC Kemps Creek Data Centre (871-901 Mamre Road)
notes: CDC filed a SEARS application with the NSW Government (reported ~Aug 2026) for a data centre at 871-901 Mamre Road, Kemps Creek, Penrith LGA. Early-stage pipeline; capacity not disclosed.

name: STACK Erskine Park data centre campus (SYD01)
notes: Stack lodged a SEARS application with NSW Government for a data centre campus with operational capacity ~450MW at Erskine Park, Penrith LGA (methodology anchor: STACK SYD01 SSD-82211208); datacenters.com lists an existing Stack Erskine Park facility. 450MW is ultimate campus operational capacity, not built IT load.

name: Digital Realty Erskine Park (SYD10 / SYD11)
notes: Digital Realty Sydney campus at 1-12 Templar Road, Erskine Park (Penrith LGA): SYD10 colocation and SYD11 (phase one delivered 2019, ~86,327 sq ft); Telecom Times reports Digital Realty investment in Penrith and plans for an additional Erskine Park facility.

name: Port Data Centre (Port Macquarie)
notes: Official site states Port Data Centre is building a regional Australian-owned Tier-3 data centre in Port Macquarie (Mid-North Coast), with N+1 generators and colocation/cloud/DR services; no completion date or council DA identified in quick search, so construction status unverified - treat as announced/planned.

name: Julius Avenue Data Centre (North Ryde)
notes: SSD-80018208, six-storey data centre at 6-8 Julius Avenue, North Ryde (Ryde LGA), ~36,328 sqm, ~170MW power capacity reported; proposal ~$1.5bn per SMH; progressed to response-to-submissions late 2025 with large community opposition.

name: Project Apollo Data Centre (Macquarie Park)
notes: SSD-74069708: $1.36bn data centre at Macquarie Park (Ryde LGA) lodged by Goodman and on public exhibition (2025-2026). Note: NSW Government announced (Aug 2026) a ban on new data centres in Macquarie Park, which may affect this and other Ryde pipeline projects.

name: Project Mars Data Centre (12 Mars Road, Macquarie Park)
notes: SSD-82052708 at 12 Mars Road, Macquarie Park (Ryde LGA), ~$1.58bn State Significant Development; received mass public submissions (In the Cove, May 2026) and Sydney Water requested pause pending further studies (Apr 2026). Methodology lists Project Mars under the Ryde/Lane Cove cluster.

name: Macquarie Park Data Centre (SSD-10467)
notes: SSD-10467 approved 28/05/2021: construction and 24-hour operation of a five-storey data storage building with ancillary office space at Macquarie Park (City of Ryde); determination stage completed; applicant not stated on the public record.

name: NEXTDC S1 & S2 (Macquarie Park)
notes: NEXTDC S1 at 4 Eden Park Drive, Macquarie Park (Ryde LGA), ~16MW and 5-storey/5,600 sqm; S2 at 6-8 Giffnock Avenue, Macquarie Park, Uptime Tier IV certified. Both operational; S1 power from datacenters.com listing.

name: Macquarie Data Centres IC3 East & IC3 Super West (Macquarie Park)
notes: Macquarie Park Data Centre Campus (Ryde LGA): IC3 East operational (opened with PM attendance, ~10MW), IC3 Super West purpose-built for AI/cloud with ~32MW IT load; official sources describe a 65MW Macquarie Park campus; linesight cites 1.28 PUE, 33kV design, 11,700+ sqm technical space.

name: Digital Realty Macquarie Park redevelopment (23-25 Waterloo Road)
notes: Baxtel notes Digital Realty is planning a redevelopment of its site at 23-25 Waterloo Road, Macquarie Park (Ryde LGA) - weak lead only; no planning record verified this round.
